_help: One entry per streamer. Key = the name you type in '/shorts gta <link> <streamer>' (lower case, no spaces). facecam = 'x,y,w,h' as fractions of the frame (0-1), or null to auto-detect. language = caption language code (en, sk, ...) or null to auto-detect. Your own copy lives in ~/.config/claude-shorts/streamers.json (never commit it).

examplestreamer.name: Example Streamer
examplestreamer.notes: Measure the facecam box from one frame of the stream and store it here.
